name: Lightbox
description: Full-screen gallery overlay for paging through images with arrow keys, on-screen controls, and a live counter.
usage:
<Lightbox
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  images={[{ src: "/photo.jpg", alt: "Team offsite", caption: "Spring offsite" }]}
/>

anatomy.description: The full-screen dialog surface that dims the page and traps focus while open.
The current image, scaled to fit the viewport, with its alt and optional caption.
Chevron buttons that mirror the arrow keys and wrap around the ends.
The live "n of m" indicator tracking the current position.

dos: Give every image meaningful alt text and a short caption where it adds context.
Open at the clicked thumbnail's index via the controlled index prop.
Let the overlay own paging; arrow keys and buttons stay in sync.
donts: Don't use a lightbox for a single image that needs zoom inspection; use ImageViewer.
Don't write long prose captions; keep them to a short label.
Don't hide the close path; Escape and the backdrop always close it.

examples.title: Gallery overlay
examples.description: A button opens the lightbox; arrow keys and the chevron buttons page through images while the counter tracks position.

examples.title: Thumbnail entry points
examples.description: Each thumbnail opens the gallery at its own index via the controlled index prop.

guidance.useWhen: Users need to inspect a set of images one at a time without leaving the page, such as photo galleries or screenshot collections.
guidance.avoidWhen: A single inline image with zoom controls is enough; use ImageViewer instead.
guidance.behavior: Wraps from the last image to the first (and back) with both keys and buttons; Escape and backdrop clicks close the overlay.
guidance.responsive: The image scales to fit the viewport while controls stay anchored to the edges on any width.

keyboard.action: Shows the next image, wrapping past the last.
Shows the previous image, wrapping before the first.

notes: Rendered as a labelled dialog that traps focus while open.
The position counter ('3 of 8') is announced via a polite live region.
Images always require alt text supplied by the caller.
